comments.text: 🇵🇹 Portugal looks peaceful, sunny, and beautiful… but behind that calm image are stories many travelers never see. 🌊 From Lisbon to Porto, Nazaré, the Algarve, Madeira, the Azores, and the sound of Fado, this country may surprise you. Would you live in Portugal? Comment below, like 👍, and subscribe 🔔! #Portugal #PortugalTravel #TravelDocumentary #Lisbon #Porto #EuropeTravel
